name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NonLattice.parity_bias_prod
title: Piling-up identity: the bias of any parity of independent Bernoulli(tau) bits is (1 - 2 tau)^(number of bits involved)
statement: For any finite index set I, coefficients c : I -> F_2 and tau real, the sum over x in F_2^I of prod_i Pr_tau(x_i) times (-1)^(sum_i c_i x_i) equals prod_i (1 if c_i = 0 else 1 - 2 tau). That is, the bias of the parity <c, x> for x with independent Bernoulli(tau) coordinates is (1 - 2 tau)^(wt c).
